configuration.question: How large are within-seed anchored-vs-free gains/losses, and how category-dependent are they?
configuration.design: Two existing neural seeds, all original cohorts, all four controls. Retain every eligible category. RealIAD3 additionally leave each of its three categories out in turn, reported as sensitivity only; no deleted-class replacement of main endpoint.
configuration.inference: 5000 paired category-label stratified acquisition-group bootstrap replicates, percentile 95% conditional intervals. Same sampled groups for every arm. Fixed categories/models/heads; no training population, selection-history or new-independent-confirmation inference. Exploratory intervals without multiplicity correction.
configuration.units: Each configured acquisition group must occur once in each domain V; asserts enforce uniqueness. No claim of new physical identity verification.
configuration.metrics: Class macro AUROC on logits; class and label-balanced Brier on existing probabilities. Negative Brier delta and positive AUROC delta favor anchored. Replay all 140 parent metric values before sensitivity.
configuration.stop: One fixed-prediction analysis; 0 fitting/NN updates/forwards/new data/Eye/SiM. All directions retained; no tuning or winner selection from V.
